rows.concrete_observation: Entire EntityIceBarrier167lines, FrostBarrier, MagicConstruct/ScaledConstruct, RenderIceBarrier and ICustomHitbox read, plus complete RayTracer methods and full sibling Forcefield.onUpdate. Actual spell caster must onGround, server builds staggered barriers nearfloor and rejects overlap; deferred list spawnEntity results ignored. Exact entity tracking160/1/velocity and renderer registration exist. Server barrier onUpdate moves vertically through extension/retraction lifetime, then AABB-grow2 candidates require actual AABB intersection and skip any EntityMagicConstruct. Signed horizontal plane distance uses entity position plus(1,0,1), and when absdistance<entity.width/2+thickness/2, adds0.25*sign(distance) along look x/z; no caster/allied/isValidTarget/hurt/canBeAffected check. PlayerMP explicitly gets native SPacketEntityVelocity. distance0 gives velocity0 yet branch can send packet, so branch is not proof actual movement. Deflect sound is unconditionally BEFORE super.attackEntityFrom; exact inherited MC1.12 Entity attack result not expanded, cannot call every sound a successful block. Native custom ray dispatcher invokes calculateIntercept then nearest position, without canBeCollidedWith filter; plane intercept uses ABS endpoint distances and AABB filter, no explicit signed opposite-side proof, no denominator0 guard; not runtime-tested. A same-side arithmetic boundary is not independent gameplay reference. Body render follows transform/size and model; no special immunity text. Parent lifetime despawns when ticksExisted>lifetime except-1; caster UUID in save, spawn resolves current integerID once. delay saved to NBT but not explicitly included in own writeSpawnData, so client extend sound equality delay+1 is not proof staggered-server timing received.
